title: RG500 Gamma 2-Stroke Legend (Sport Black)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Suzuki RG500 Gamma 2-Stroke Legend (Sport Black) is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 500cc powertrain delivering 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 163 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
